name: Setting Up a Build x Brand Slack Workspace
trigger: An Account Manager needs a new Slack workspace for a Build x Brand client relationship.
purpose: Creates a Build x Brand client Slack workspace nested inside Build Dynamics' Enterprise Grid. Two things go wrong otherwise: a workspace created from personal Slack is standalone and invisible to the org directory, and external contacts invited to the default general channel do not work. This is the correct process, start to finish.
doneWhen: The workspace shows up nested at brickdynamics.enterprise.slack.com and external contacts were invited to the brick-[brandname] channel, not general.
timeToRun: About 5 minutes to submit, plus admin approval wait

steps.title: Request the workspace through the org directory
steps.trigger: You know the client or brand name for the new workspace.
steps.work: Go to brickdynamics.enterprise.slack.com, scroll to the bottom to "Can't find your workspace? … ask your admins to create a new workspace", click it and submit a request under the brand's name. Never use Slack's general Create a New Workspace option from personal Slack.
rules: Never create the workspace from personal Slack's Create a New Workspace option.

steps.title: Slack admin approves the request
steps.trigger: A workspace request arrives from the org directory.
steps.work: Sam reviews and approves the request. Once approved the new workspace appears nested under the org with a default general channel inside it.
steps.doneWhen: The workspace is visible in the org's Workspace Directory.

steps.title: Create the brick-[brandname] channel
steps.trigger: The approved workspace is visible with its default general channel.
steps.work: Inside the new workspace create a new channel named brick-[brandname], for example brick-bridgeway. Do not rename general.
rules: Do not rename general to brick-[brand]; create a dedicated channel.

steps.title: Invite external client contacts to the new channel
steps.work: Invite the external client contacts to the brick-[brandname] channel specifically, not to general.

steps.title: Did it work?
steps.work: Check two things: the workspace shows up nested at brickdynamics.enterprise.slack.com rather than in your personal My Workspaces list, and external contacts were invited to brick-[brandname], not general.

steps.title: Stop and confirm with Sam
steps.trigger: Either check failed, or a standalone workspace was created by mistake.
steps.work: Don't invite anyone yet. If a standalone workspace was created with little activity, delete it and redo the steps. If people are already active in it, ask Sam about migrating the workspace into the org, which preserves members. If unsure whether the request went through, check with Sam directly.
